rule: D-LIB18-SIZE (lib-18-card ruling 14): every number a card does not give, each Mistake's magnitude and each 'slight bend' included, fixed here before PQ-H3 is measured, each with its basis: a claim id, an approved plate's value (file:line) used as a convention, or a stated physical reason in numbers. PQ-H3 is never a basis. A spec's exported SIZES table equals its row here and every row is used (A17, both ways); a composer's exported constants equal theirs; `trace` is the spec's trace point (D-LIB18-TRACE). Values marked 'solved' are computed by the spec from the rule in their basis and exported by it.

PAD_R.basis: stated reason: c4 'a barbell pad': a foam roll about 3 cm thick round the 28 mm shaft (equipment.mjs:261 shaftD 0.028), so 4.5 cm from the bar's centre to the pad's face

GRIP_X.basis: claim: c24 'grip it just wider than hip width apart': the hips 33.4 cm wide (body.mjs WINTER.hipW 0.191 H at 1.75 m) plus 3 cm each side

PLATE_D.basis: convention: equipment.mjs:261 (the vendor barbell's 450 mm plates)

SLEEVE_D.basis: convention: equipment.mjs:261 (the vendor barbell's 50 mm sleeve)

BENCH_W.basis: convention: equipment.mjs:157 (the vendor bench, 29 cm wide), seen end-on

FLOOR_BACK.basis: stated reason: layout: the floor line runs 35 cm behind the bench's back edge, past the hanging head

FLOOR_FRONT.basis: stated reason: layout: the floor line runs 30 cm past the toes

BENCH_TOP.basis: physical, from the card's top facts: with the shin plumb (c6), the knee 90 (c8), the foot flat (c1) and the shoulders, hips and knees on one level line (c8), the hip sits a shank plus the ankle height up (0.4985 m); the upper back (backUpper) on that line is the bench edge's height (c2, c9): solved 0.3728 m

START_TILT.basis: physical: c10 'slowly lowering back to the ground': lowered on the bench-edge pivot (c9) until the first of the 45 cm plates and the buttock reaches the floor (the plates first): solved -37.82 deg

M_TILT.basis: claim: c12 (Contreras) 'substitutes by arching the back' to lock the weight out: with the lumbar at M_ARCH, the bar at the top's height, the upper back on the edge (c9) and the feet planted: solved -83.44 deg

trace.basis: claim: c8 'Push the bar towards the ceiling by extending your hips' (D-LIB18-TRACE: the bar in the hip crease); the bar rides the pelvis, and the hip joint is the landmark under it (the engine traces landmarks only, plate.mjs:159)

STANCE_X.basis: convention: single_leg_romanian_deadlift.mjs (pilot A @ dcac4a38):43, the standing mid-sole under the standing hip

STANCE_KNEE.basis: convention: leg_press.mjs:13 'knees 15 deg short of lockout' (no claim gives the standing knee; D-LIB16-LOCK: no locked joint the card does not ask for)

KNEE_SOFT.basis: claim c5 'only a subtle bend at the knee' / 'knee slightly flexed', sized by convention leg_press.mjs:13, :23 (D-LIB18-SIZE)

END_HIP_EXT.basis: stated reason [UNVERIFIED source, needs ruling]: c6 'as far as possible without rotating in the hips' = the hip's extension stop with the pelvis held; clinical tables found 2026-10-23 give 10-15 deg (an unsourced clinical form) and 17 +- 3.9 deg (an AAOS-based table); the primary papers (Roach & Miles 1991, Phys Ther 71:656; Roaas & Andersson 1982, Acta Orthop 53:205) could not be opened (502)

START_TOE_CLEAR.basis: stated reason: the working foot just off the floor (c2 most of the weight on the other leg), as single_leg_romanian_deadlift's free toe 2.7 cm up (header :31)

START_ANKLE.basis: stated reason: no claim gives the start foot; the engine's neutral ankle (foot square to the shank), as the standing foot

ELBOW_SOFT.basis: convention: machine_chest_press.mjs:45 (18 deg short of straight, the elbow basis per D-LIB18-SIZE)

M_ARCH.basis: convention: hanging_leg_raise.mjs:69 trunk -12, 'pelvis tipped forward so the lower back arches (lumbar extension 12 deg)' (D-LIB18-SIZE; LB6 M_ARCH 12)

TOE_OUT.basis: stated reason: c12 'toes slightly pointed out' with c13 'ensure your knees align with your toes': at the FOOT_X stance the toe line that lies in the leg's own bend plane with the sole flat on the plate, so the knee tracks the toes; at 8 deg every foot contact holds within 0.2 cm (start 0.1, end 0.2), while leg_press.mjs:32's 15 deg leaves the toe 7 deg off the knee plane and the sole 0.8-1.5 cm off its plate point
